answer: My answer to sybils is Food-handler certificate with health department attestation — a certificate number in the health department system — which makes the delta of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the canyon is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The inlet grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
